title: speq module v1
description: One file in the modules directory, parsed as ModuleSpec in speq-cli/src/runner/mod.rs. A test imports a module and calls its actions from a 'use' step. Note there is no 'module:' wrapper key — 'actions' and 'variables' sit at the top level. Any string value may carry an '${VAR}' placeholder, resolved from the OS environment when the file is loaded; '${VAR:-default}' supplies a fallback and '$${VAR}' is a literal. Substitution happens before this schema applies, so a placeholder is never itself validated against the field's type.

variables.description: Variables available to every action in this module.

actions.description: Callable actions, keyed by name. A 'use' step reaches one as '<module-or-alias>.<action>'.

action.description: Either the full form, or the legacy shorthand of a bare step array. ModuleActionSpec is an untagged enum, so both parse.

oneOf.title: legacy shorthand
oneOf.description: A bare array of steps, equivalent to the full form with only 'steps'. It can take no properties and can return nothing.

properties.description: Parameter names this action requires. The calling 'use' step must supply each one in its own 'properties' block.

returns.description: Values the action hands back to the caller, which binds them under the 'use' step's 'as' name. Each expression must be '$steps.<id>.response.body.<path>', and <id> must match the 'id' of a step in this action — validate_module_content enforces both, but the referenced id cannot be checked by a schema.
